data.name: Avinas
data.gender_notes: Avinas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avinas is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of prosperity'. It is a name that holds significant importance in Hindu mythology, associated with the god Avinas, who is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success. The name Avinas carries the meaning “Lord of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avinas usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the prosperity-giving deity bless you with abundance and prosperity.
data.etymology: Avinas belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avinas total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
